assessments.reasoning: The supplied questionnaire does not include any questions asking whether a person supervises or remains available to care for other household members while performing other activities or without care being their primary activity. Care is mentioned only as a response category for not seeking work (question j7, option 3), not working additional hours (question h16, option 5), or not being available to start work (question j12, option 4). As per the indicator rules, care given as a reason for not working or for not working more hours does not count. Supervisory care or availability to care is not mentioned at all in the instrument.
